readmeExcerpt: Simple Docker Compose setup to run Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) connected to an Oracle AI Database Free container!
highlights: **ords**: ORDS container for exposing REST APIs. The ORDS HTTP dashboard is available on http://localhost:8888
**ordsdb**: Oracle AI Database container. The database container externally accessible at testuser/testpwd@localhost:1555/freepdb1
metaTitle: Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) + Oracle AI Database with Docker Compose | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Docker Compose setup for running ORDS with Oracle AI Database Free locally.
